items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 02 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland as various fronts affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southeast 5 or 6, quickly veering southwest 4 or 5, veering west or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 tonight, backing southwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, drizzle or mist continuing to quickly clear to the east. Otherwise isolated rain or showers.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, but moderate or poor in the east at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, increasing more generally 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain clearing to isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
